Worlds with ores 1.4.0 for Minecraft Forge 1.20.1

SUMMARY
- Portal worlds, industrial multi-ore terrain, Lava Obsidian gear
- Portal Flux: reactor, cables, wireless, T5 coils, FE tools/armor

CHANGES IN 1.4.0
- Flux cables + wireless transmitter/receiver (Linker, range 48)
- Singularity / Nexus coil upgrades (T4/T5)
- FE axe, shovel, hoe, sword + full Flux armor (NV, absorb, speed, fall, magnet)
- Core Flux no longer marked WIP

CURSEFORGE UPLOAD
1. Upload: dist/curseforge/worlds_with_ores-1.4.0-1.20.1.jar
2. Game versions: Forge 1.20.1
3. Release type: Release
4. Paste CHANGELOG_CF.txt into the changelog field
